The '''Ithica system''' was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the items known as [[Ithica box]]es.<ref name="Lando">{{Tales|5|Lando's Commandos: On Eagles' Wings}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Ithica box]]es|system=Ithica [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ithica [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-14.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
